answer: A bond is refunded only after 31 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. The comet counter is kept in dawn and pulse exposes each reset. Anyone thus has to keep every alias continuously active for 31 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. A farm of 3224 identities would post 831 proofs and burn roughly 78 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
